list: the official 55 trophies, launch day 19 November 2026

trophies.guide: Pops automatically once the other 54 are earned. Follow the roadmap: story, strangers, activities, crime, then cleanup. About 200 hours in total.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: 100% is a 35-task checklist (story, strangers, stunts, collectibles and more). Track it in the in-game stats; finish the story first, then mop up the checklist items one by one.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Story trophy — play through to the end. Keep a manual save before the finale; there is no mission replay, so a save lets you revisit the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime; they add up across free roam. Use fast cars and the stunt jumps scattered around Leonida, and chip away at the count during story play.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting ranges and gold-medal all 42 challenges. Learn each weapon's recoil in practice first, then go for gold one weapon at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Hit five bank vaults and escape the Wanted level each time. Bring a fast getaway car and a planned route out of the area before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.guide: Stranger missions appear as “?” encounters around Leonida (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal and more). Finish eight full strands; new “?” markers appear as the story advances.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in sets. Collect three full sets; use the in-game collectible tracker and sweep one district at a time.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is a photo/check-in activity — do it at 100 distinct spots. A long grind, so fold it into exploration while you work on exploring all of Leonida.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Story mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 of the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 of the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 of the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 of the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story heist mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the heist ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story mission. Keep playing the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — follow the “?” markers; the final mission unlocks after the earlier ones in the strand.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand — follow the “?” markers until the strand's final mission appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand — follow the “?” markers until the strand's final mission appears.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand — follow the “?” markers until the strand's final mission appears.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand — follow the “?” markers until the strand's final mission appears.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's strand ends in a hunt — track the unique animal he names and hunt it in the wilds of Leonida. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's strand ends in a fishing challenge — win it. Practise the fishing minigame first; timing the reel is what wins it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Hit a jewelry store without being spotted — go quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before any alarm. A stealth approach and a fast car help.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the Wanted level. A heavy vehicle to block it helps.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping the same Wanted level — don't lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route through three nearby shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner.
trophies.guide: With your partner, build up to 4 stars, then escape — break line of sight, swap cars, and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation of each gang.
trophies.guide: Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; rob one from every gang. Scope them out first and hit them when guards are thin.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through the laundering contact until you have cleaned $250,000. Keep robbing to keep the bills flowing.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, take a plane out without a scheduled flight — steal one and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the tank — get into one and stir things up. The trophy is a joke on the tank's name; just climb in and cause chaos.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Defeat 5 enemies in one Combat Focus use.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-mo aiming mode — activate it with five enemies in view and take them all down before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.guide: Challenges are the open-world checklists (stunts, races, collectibles and more). Complete any 50 — they stack up naturally across the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Try each of 9 activity types once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types — races, fishing, shooting range, arcade, drone racing, WAiNK It, meditation and more. One try each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at several spots; win at each one. Learn the course lines — cutting corners cleanly is what wins races.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races (street, off-road, boat, air). Vary the vehicle class and track — each first win counts.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one full game. Any cabinet counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — meditate at every meditation spot. Do this as you explore and don't rush past spots; a spot tied to a story window may not come back.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Find and drive 100 distinct vehicles — the discovery counter ticks when you enter a new model. Variety matters; try everything from scooters to trucks.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.guide: Visit every named area of the map. Drive the whole state — the map clears as you go; check it for unexplored corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total in shops (clothes, weapons, food). It adds up across the game; big weapon and car purchases speed it up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages. Save up — they are pricey; heist and laundering income helps.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles you own to the Scooter Bros app (the in-game rideshare/delivery app). Register each new ride as you acquire it.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. The trophy pops when you sit with the drink overlooking the water.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash out of a vehicle showroom.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out through the glass of a vehicle showroom. Pick a showroom, line up, and floor it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow through at Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game. Follow through on the lane — finish the game.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock targets down like pins. Line up a group and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy tied to a partnership moment — it pops during a specific story/side beat involving a partnership. Keep playing; it unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Tied to making a significant choice — the trophy pops when a major decision lands. There is no way to force it early; play on.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy that pops on a second attempt at something — retry what failed and it lands.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A hidden, oddball trophy — something strange happens in Leonida and it pops. Explore the weird corners of the map.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
